LightningComponentBundle.description: Thin Experience Cloud / Lightning shell that opens the BambooHR Get Pricing BFF (Revenue Cloud APIs run server-side). Set Custom Label RLM_Bamboo_Get_Pricing_Bff_Url or the design-time BFF URL property.

property.name: bffUrlOverride
property.label: BFF base URL override
property.description: Optional. When set, overrides Custom Label RLM_Bamboo_Get_Pricing_Bff_Url.

property.name: autoRedirect
property.label: Auto-redirect on load
property.description: When true, navigates to the BFF immediately after load.

property.name: openInNewTab
property.label: Open BFF in a new tab
property.description: When true, Get Pricing opens a new browser tab.
